channel.description: Latest articles from Place North West (placenorthwest.co.uk)

item.title: St Helens approves eight-storey town centre hotel
item.description: Bury-based Sterling Property, connected to the group of businesses controlled by billionaire Together founder Henry Moser, has secured consent for an 82-bed scheme. The post St Helens approves eight-storey town centre hotel appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Plans lodged for 55,000 sq ft EFT-anchored complex
item.description: Sefton Council has taken receipt of an application for the local employer's base and some commercial units on a vacant plot at Southport Business Park. The post Plans lodged for 55,000 sq ft EFT-anchored complex appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: ACC Liverpool plans 370-seat increase
item.description: The arena has shared its ambitions to create a ‘super suite’ and increase its capacity, filing a variation to premises licence application with the city council. The post ACC Liverpool plans 370-seat increase appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: GRAHAM to build 2,300-bed Manchester PBSA
item.description: Manchester Metropolitan University and Unite Students have appointed the contractor to deliver the £286m redevelopment of the Cambridge Halls student village. The post GRAHAM to build 2,300-bed Manchester PBSA appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: £525m wastewater upgrade coming to Salford
item.description: United Utilities has outlined ambitions for £225m-worth of improvements to the city’s wastewater treatment works and £300m to Eccles’ over the next five years. The post £525m wastewater upgrade coming to Salford appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Stockport rubber-stamps funding for 200 homes
item.description: The council’s cabinet housing committee has signed off backing for four developments to be progressed by Stockport Homes Group, with a combined value of £57.4m. The post Stockport rubber-stamps funding for 200 homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Kier secures Chinese e-commerce giant at Manchester trade park
item.description: JD.com has signed for 9,250 sq ft at Trade City in Cheetham Hill. The post Kier secures Chinese e-commerce giant at Manchester trade park appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: M&S maps out return to Northwich
item.description: Cheshire West and Chester Council has agreed terms on a land deal with Rothstone Estates that will see the retailer deliver an 18,000 sq ft foodhall on the site of a former depot off Leicester Street. The post M&S maps out return to Northwich appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Govt U-turns on local election postponements on legal grounds
item.description: Elections in Lancashire and across the country will go ahead as planned in May after the government reversed a decision to delay them following a legal challenge by Reform UK. The post Govt U-turns on local election postponements on legal grounds appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Green light for revised £100m Eden Project Morecambe
item.description: The long-awaited attraction, expected to act as a catalyst for the regeneration of the coastal resort, could finally get going this year after Lancaster City Council gave the go-ahead to the “recalibrated” proposal. The post Green light for revised £100m Eden Project Morecambe appeared first on Place North West.
